title: Business Cardholder Guarantee Uplift
content:
**Q. What is the business cardholder guarantee uplift?**
A. An amount added to the Plus guarantee refund of a membership of Northgate Memberships according to the business add-on cards in use on it. It is added to the guarantee refund of a year that shows a guarantee shortfall; a year without a guarantee shortfall pays nothing.

**Q. Which cards are "in use"?**
A. The business add-on cards in use are those issued on the membership without a later deactivation — counted from the membership's card records as business add-on cards issued less business add-on cards deactivated. Household cards and the primary member's card do not count.

**Q. How much?**

| Business add-on cards in use | Business cardholder guarantee uplift |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 2.50 dollars |
| 1 or 2 | 1.00 dollar |
| none | nothing |

Three or more in use add a business cardholder guarantee uplift of 2.50 dollars, one or two in use add 1.00 dollar, and none adds nothing.

**Q. Hypothetical: four add-on cards issued, one of them later removed?**
A. Three in use — 2.50 dollars.

**Q. Hypothetical: two add-on cards issued, both later deactivated?**
A. None in use — nothing.

**Q. Hypothetical: a consumer Plus membership with one household card?**
A. Household cards are not business add-on cards — nothing.
